title: Custom-Size Door Units on Entry & Patio Door Contracts
content:
Each door unit on an Entry & Patio Door Contract is measured at the final measure and compared with the series standard sizes, width by height in inches.

## Pricing rule

- A unit that fits a standard size is priced in the base price.
- A unit at any other size is built to custom size and carries the series custom-size surcharge per unit.
- The surcharge is written as one custom-size surcharge change order line dated the final measure date for all such units together. The line amount is the series surcharge per unit times the number of custom-size units, rounded to the cent.
- This line is not a customer change order and never counts toward the free or maximum change-order counts.
- A remeasure that changes the custom-size count after the final measure is re-priced by a customer change order, never by a second automatic line.

## Input, judgement, result

| Input | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Measured unit size is on the series standard list | Standard size | Priced in the base price; no surcharge |
| Measured unit size is not on the series standard list | Custom size | Series surcharge per unit, on the single custom-size line dated the final measure date |
| A later remeasure changes how many units are custom size | Change to the custom-size count | Re-priced by a customer change order; no second automatic line |

## Worked example (hypothetical final measure)

A Ridgeline Portal 310 Steel Entry Door contract has three units measured at the final measure: 36x80, 36x96 and 36x96. The Portal 310 standard sizes are 32x80, 34x80 and 36x80, and its surcharge is $295.00 per unit. The 36x80 unit is standard. The two 36x96 units are custom size, so one line of two times $295.00, that is $590.00, is written dated the final measure date. That line does not use up any of the contract's free change orders and does not count toward its maximum.

The same three sizes on a Ridgeline Portal 520 Smooth Fiberglass Entry Door contract would carry no surcharge, since 36x96 is a standard size of the Portal 520 series.
